content: Follow BIBREF9 inaguma2018speech, we use CNN-BiLSTM architecture to build our model. Specifically, the input features $\mathbf {x}$ are organized as a sequence of feature vectors in length $T_x$. Then, $\mathbf {x}$ is passed into a stack of two convolutional layers followed by max-pooling:
